newsitem.title: FRANCE: Airport mixup causes Waigel to delay summit start.
newsitem.headline: Airport mixup causes Waigel to delay summit start.

text.p: German finance minister Theo Waigel arrived more than an hour late for a Franco-German economic summit meeting on Wednesday because his military plane landed at the wrong airport, German officials said.
The aircraft landed at Lyon's civilian Satolas airport by mistake. It should have landed at the military airport where cars where waiting to pick Waigel up, they said.
Waigel's late arrival delayed the start of the meeting by more than an hour from its scheduled starting time of 0900 GMT,

At the last Franco-German economic summit in September, Waigel was unable to land in the Bavarian town of Kempten because of bad weather and his plane was diverted to Stuttgart, delaying the start of that meeting.
The summit is also being attended by Bundesbank president Hans Tietmeyer, French Finance Minister Jean Aruthuis and French central bank governor Jean-Claude Trichet.
